sections.text:
Check and clean excitation 
transformer components.

Check and clean the 
cooling fans of thyristor and their alarm system.

Check and clean the 
equipment of the thyristor pannels using comprissed air.

Clean the air filter of 
thyristor pannels using compressed air

Check gate terminal of the 
thyristor with the aid of special marrior to ensure the proper terminal 
connrction.

Check and clean auto 
voltage regulator component.

فحص وتنظيف المقدمة 
اتصالات الكسارة وقياس الخلوص بين الاتصال المتحرك والثابت 
الاتصال وتعديله إذا لزم الأمر.

Check and clean the 
discharge resistance contacts and measure the clearance between moving contact 
and fixed contact and readjust it if necessary.

Check and clean field 
flashing breaker contact.

Check and test excitation 
over current relay (two stages).

Check all protection 
signals for excitation system with the unit control board.

Operate the field breaker 
(ON - OFF) for test while checking the performance of the discharge resistance 
contact synchronising with the main field breaker contacts operation.
